sources.citation: Glottolog 5.x languoid record 'Luxi Achang' luxi1238 (language-level under Achangic acha1252; split from Achang [acn] on Xiong Shunqing 2015, LTBA 38(2): 208); zero descriptive references attached.

戴庆厦、崔志超 Dai Qingxia & Cui Zhichao. 1985. 阿昌语简志 [A brief description of the Achang language]. 中国少数民族语言简志丛书. 北京: 民族出版社. 3+141 pp. Chapter 方言 pp. 81-97 (pdf leaves 86-102) compares Longchuan / Luxi (江东公社高埂田话, Jiangdong Gaogengtian) / Lianghe.
sources.note: Nothing about stress (重音/轻重音) anywhere in the book. For Luxi the dialect chapter gives 28 initials (p. 81), 65 rhymes with codas -p -t -k -ʔ -m -n -ŋ (pp. 83-84), four tones 55/51/35/31, checked rhymes only on 55 and 31 (p. 86), tone correspondences pp. 87-90. The 弱化 (weakened first syllable) remark on p. 22 concerns the Longchuan base variety only; Luxi forms are cited without weakened syllables. Pages 81-98 read from rendered page scan.
